responsibility: This file implements GCC’s tree debugging and dump printers. It can print tree nodes briefly or recursively in full detail, including declaration/type names, constant values, addresses, locations, and selected structure-specific fields, and also provides helper formatting for declaration identifiers and debugger entry points such as debug_tree, debug_raw, and hook-based slim dumps. Its responsibility is human-readable inspection of tree IR nodes and related objects, not generic pretty-printing of language syntax or GIMPLE statements.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/print-tree.h, which only declares the tree debug/printing entry points and flags, this file implements the actual traversal and formatting of tree nodes, including detailed and brief dumps, declaration/type formatting, and debugger helper routines.
